The structure of Dy8Ga16Si16 (Dy(GaSi)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Fmmm (No. 119), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 Ga/Si neighbors, while Ga and Si each have 9 geometric neighbors, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between Dy and Ga 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Dy and Si 12-vertex polyhedra.
